title: Stateless Language Agents: Scaling Long-Horizon Automated Research
abstract_summary: Long-horizon automated research does not automatically convert more inference into more progress: agents replay growing histories, duplicate one another's work, or stop experimenting while token consumption continues. SLA keeps the research state in the harness and reconstructs a fresh, role-specific context for every invocation; a stateless Advisor assigns concrete experiments to parallel Workers. Evaluated on software engineering, kernel optimization, and algorithm design at budgets up to 1B tokens.

title: GitSwarm: Decentralized Compounding Inference
abstract_summary: Compounding inference over a shared, branchable Git repository: asynchronous homogeneous workers explore, experiment, verify, refine, and synthesize via atomic commits and explicit cross-branch semantic dependencies. On ProgramBench, 94.7% of contributions are subsequently built upon and the selected solution's transitive ancestry covers 82-93% of the contribution graph. On NanoChat, 70.1% of negative-labelled research commits are cited by later accepted contributions.

title: DuoDiscover: Scaling Autonomous Discovery Beyond the Evaluation Bottleneck
abstract_summary: Evaluation is the bottleneck for autonomous discovery: a single true evaluation can take hours, so a search can afford only a handful. DuoDiscover co-discovers an optimization target and a cheap proxy evaluator (a 'yardstick'), hill-climbs the yardstick, and uses fidelity tests plus true evaluations to invalidate drifting proxies. It scales from repository-level software to GPU/TPU kernels and chip microarchitecture.

title: SHELDON: Reasoning through Dual Search over Hypothesis and Observation Spaces
metadata_source: tests/fixtures/arxiv_metadata_snapshot.json (2610.18025 のエントリは 2026-10-21 に abs ページ取得・確認後に追加)
abstract_summary: Test-time scaling approaches couple observation discovery to existing hypotheses. SHELDON separately represents and jointly explores a hypothesis space and an observation space, connected by explicit evidence relations, so that it can discover observations its current hypotheses do not explain; such unexplained observations expose gaps, motivate new investigations, and guide hypothesis generation beyond refinements. Across diagnosis, abstract reasoning and optimization benchmarks it outperforms evaluated baselines by up to 26.7 points, and generates up to 4.5x more novel solutions.

title: Stellar Colosseum: A Many-Agent Harness for Long-Horizon Research in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science
venue: arXiv:2609.15983v2 [cs.AI]。v1（2026-09-14）／v2（2026-09-15、最新）。カテゴリは cs.AI / cs.CL / cs.LG（2026-10-21 に abs ページで確認。引継ぎ資料 docs/worker-handoff-literature-2026-10-21.md の「cs.AI / cs.CL / cs.CL」は第3カテゴリの誤記で、正しくは cs.LG）
abstract_summary: A model-agnostic many-agent harness for long-horizon research in mathematics and theoretical computer science. It explores alternative strategies before proof construction, uses a readiness gate to decide when a route is mature enough to decompose, represents the proof plan as interdependent section-level subproblems, and routes verifier findings back to the affected part of the argument. Within each stage it generates candidates in parallel, attacks them with targeted falsification, and combines candidates with their critiques through overlapping random-sample tree aggregation. On TCS-Bench it reaches 71.0% accuracy with Gemini 3.1 Pro and Gemini 3.7 Flash; a Codeforces pipeline solves 218 of 222 problems. Integrated into Google Antigravity's Teamwork framework as the Long Proof pattern.
note: 2026-10-21 に abs ページと HTML v2（全17チャンク）を通読。書誌（title/authors 6名/published 2026-09-14）は fixture と一致したため fixture の修正は不要。本文読解は contributions/2026-10-21_stellar_colosseum_reading.md。Appendix A のプロンプトは HTML に埋め込まれた base64 をデコードして逐語性を確認した。PDF は未取得、v1 との差分比較は未実施、図の内部はキャプションのみ確認。--live 照合は未実施。

title: The Agentic Scientist: Orchestrating Coding Agents for Automated Scientific (Co-)Discovery
abstract_summary: 草案化・アイデア生成・計画・サンドボックス実験・結果統合・ベースライン／アブレーション・事後分析・報告の8活動を、4段階のパイプライン（課題草案化／並列調査／遡及的証拠生成／根拠づけられた執筆）として接続する Sakana AI のオーケストレーション層。各段階は headless コーディングエージェントが担い、エージェント自身が草案するルーブリックで自己検証する。メタコントローラが並列ワーカーを管理し、段階ごとにルーブリック検証を強制する。ALIFE 2026 採択論文1本（人間の検証・編集つき）と、ハイパーネットワーク適応・CMA アンカー付き学習型 ES などの自律発見を報告。
